newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oman and Tunisia withdraw their representatives in Tel Aviv.
- Five Islamists arrested in Amman for planning bomb attacks in Israel.
- Saudi's al-Zamel air conditioning company signs a 100 million riyal contract with the U.S. firm General Electric to produce air conditioning units in Saudi Arabia.
- Egypt discusses with four Arab countries the possibility of setting up a free trade zone.
- Turkey bans wearing of Islamic hijab in universities.
- Syria has no reservation against Palestinian President Arafat's visit to Damascus.
- Kuwaiti Bayan investment company to be launched on Monday with a capital of $133 million.
- Egyptian textile plants threaten to halt purchase of European equipment.
